title: devflow agent contract
description: Tells the devflow skills how this repository is verified, run and documented. Private to each developer: stored under ~/.config/devflow/contracts/<host>/<owner>/<repo>.json, never inside the repository.

version.description: Contract format version. Bumped only on breaking changes. Migrating older contracts is planned for onboard's audit mode.

workflow.description: Who owns the development cycle in this repository. devflow (default): the devflow skills run the cycle. repo: the repository's own workflow applies, devflow's cycle skills stand aside and point to it, and hooks stay silent. Knowledge skills still apply.

verify.description: Shell commands, run from the repository root. Each must exit 0 when the change is good. Required unless workflow is repo. A missing e2e means the repo has no end-to-end suite yet: skills skip that check and report it, never improvise one.

fast.description: Seconds-range check for quick feedback after edits, e.g. type-check plus lint. A Stop hook that runs it is planned.

full.description: Everything CI checks before merge. pull-request requires a green run of this on the current commit.

e2e.description: End-to-end suite over the critical flows. Optional while the repo has none.

run.description: How an agent starts the app to look at a change.

dev.description: Starts the app against the default backend. Prefer a mode that needs no real backend or credentials.

mocked.description: true when run.dev works without a real backend or secrets.

login.description: Path to a doc that explains how an agent signs in to the running app.

environments.description: Backends the app can run against, when there is more than one. Before starting work on a feature, implement asks which one to use, because the choice usually depends on who you are working with.

dev.description: Command that starts the app against this backend.

e2e.description: Headless end-to-end command against this backend, when it differs from verify.e2e.

docs.description: Repository-relative paths to the domain knowledge agents must read.

glossary.description: Ubiquitous-language glossary, usually GLOSSARY.md (older repos: CONTEXT.md).

prd.description: Directory where distill writes product requirement documents.

tracker.description: Where work items live. distill writes there; implement reads from there.

project.description: Project key or board identifier, e.g. a Jira key.

skill.description: Repository skill that knows the tracker's fields and templates. When set, distill delegates ticket creation to it.

path.description: For kind local: directory holding one folder per feature with spec.md and issues/NN-slug.md files. Usually .scratch.

review.description: Repository skills that review adds to its generic pass.

template.description: Path to the pull request body template.

evidence.description: Command that uploads screenshots and prints markdown to embed.
